The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. Anna's count goes to 2 and Bob's to 1 in your example, and reps with none in the period still show 0.

- **`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStorePart07.java`**: `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` adds `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the counting subquery, the same filter the other purchase-order reports use. I also added a sentence to its Javadoc saying cancelled orders are excluded.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`**: the `purchaseOrder` helper takes a status (the old signature delegates with `SENT`), and a new test `leavesOutCancelledPurchaseOrders` reproduces your example.

`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes (4 tests, 0 failures). I ran only that class, not the full suite. Nothing is committed.
